nuggets.text: The Minutemen stunned Rutgers 37-21 in their opener, snapping a 16-game losing streak.
The Rutgers win was the first time UMass had beaten a power conference opponent since 1978.
Joe Harasymiak's parents and brothers watched him beat Rutgers, where he was defensive coordinator from 2022 to 2024.
Joe Harasymiak was the youngest head coach in Division I football when Maine hired him in 2015.
Joe Harasymiak set a Springfield College record with 17 interceptions as a defensive back.
The Minutemen swept all three MAC weekly awards: William 'Pop' Watson III, Jahmad Harmon and kicker Derek Morris.
William 'Pop' Watson III is the first Minuteman since Liam Coen in 2008 with three TD passes on 80% passing.
The Minutemen added 56 new players this year: 30 transfers and 26 freshmen.
McGuirk Alumni Stadium serves the UMass Amherst campus but actually sits across the town line in Hadley.
At McGuirk Alumni Stadium, the lowest seats in the stands are more than 12 feet off the ground.
